changes: Improved overall performance, detection speed and system responsiveness.
Improved tracking stability and smoother target acquisition.
Optimized resource usage for better performance while gaming.
Improved CUDA, DirectML and TensorRT compatibility and performance.
NexusAimV2 is now fully adapted for use with the Titan Two GPC.
Added configuration information directly inside the Titan Two GPC.
Updated setting activation indicators: enabled options now appear green with 'Enabled', while disabled options appear grey with 'Disabled'.
Migrated to a new server infrastructure for faster response times and improved security.
Improved license system security and added full support for trial licenses.
General stability, compatibility and performance improvements.
